title: Detail page shows your play activity for the game
description: The detail header gains a quiet line from the local recorder: total time, session count, and relative last-played ('18.5 h over 14 sessions · last played 2 days ago'). Hidden for a game with no recorded sessions - no useless 'never played' chrome.
commit_message: Show play activity on the game detail page
